remarks: Welcome to 20 Church Street, a beautifully renovated one-bedroom residence in the heart of downtown Greenwich. This bright and airy apartment features high ceilings, hardwood floors, and a kitchen and bathroom in pristine, triple-mint condition. Natural light and views of Long Island Sound enhance the sense of tranquility throughout the space. Ideally located just moments from Greenwich Avenue-with premier shopping, dining, and walking distance to the train-this home offers the perfect balance of luxury and convenience. Residents enjoy exceptional building amenities, including a 24-hour doorman, private garage access, same-floor laundry, dedicated storage, and a bike room. An exceptional opportunity for elegant, maintenance-free living in one of Greenwich's most desirable locations.
